Question Choices: Select the equation with Infinitely Many solutions: ~~$3x+6=3(x+2)$ | $x+2=x+5$ | $3x=9$~~
Hints: Look for an equation that simplifies to the same thing on both sides
Solution: Expand and combine like terms in 3 × x+6=3 × (x+2). Both sides are identical for every real value; subtracting gives 0=0. There are infinitely many solutions. The equation with unequal constants after cancellation has no solution; the remaining equation with a nonzero variable coefficient has one solution.
